angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 848,754 km at 35.24 pc = 0.32 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 28.3757 +/- 0.0213 mas (same row, RUWE 0.98): 35.24 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.22 +/- 0.04 solar radii from Sulis et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 73344 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...688A..14S/abstract): 848,754 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.2 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Sulis et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 73344 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...688A..14S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6252.6 +/- 1.87 K from Sulis et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 73344 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...688A..14S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Sulis et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 73344 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...688A..14S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-73344.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.345, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 73344 (pscomppars): spectral type F6 V, from Sulis et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...688A..14S/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 73344 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.16 dex, from Zhang et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..200Z/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 73344 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.26184, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 73344 (pscomppars): age 1.15 Gyr, from Sulis et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...688A..14S/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 73344 (pscomppars): rotation period 9.03 d, from Zhang et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..200Z/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 73344 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 5.67 km/s, from Zhang et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..200Z/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (1.22 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.830. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
